sources.text: Skip to content XI FANG LAB Research Focus Understanding the molecular basis of cardiac development and diseases. Spotlight News June 202 6: Congratulations to Emily Barrios Garcia for defending her Master’s Thesis on Detection of Endogenous DELE1 in Heart During Mitochondrial Stress. June 202 5 : Congratulations to Emily Sanchez Garcia for earning her Bachelor’s degree in Human Biology. She will continue in UCSD’s B.S./M.S. continuation program in our lab. June 202 5 : Congratulations to Tiana Tran for earning her Bachelor’s degree in Public Health with a Concentration in Medicine Sciences. June 202 5: Congratulations to Angela Deanne Paloma for earning her Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. May 202 5: Congratulations to Anny Huang for earning the URS-Eureka! Research Scholarship, a full-time summer research fellowship. May 202 5: Dr. Fang was awarded an Outstanding Investigator Award from the International Society for Heart Research (ISHR) for making major and independent contribution to the advancement of cardiovascular science. April 202 5: Angela Wang presents in UCSD’s Undergraduate Research Conference. January 202 5: Congratulations to Wenhui Wei for earning an American Heart Association (AHA) postdoctoral fellowship. December 202 4: Our lab published a paper in Springer Nature Link focusing on the row of GATAD1 in the causation of Cardiomyopathy. June 2024 : Our lab published a paper in Journal of Molecular and Cellular Cardiology Plus focusing on the effect of Dietary linoleic acid supplementation on established cardiomyopathy in Barth syndrome. Meet the PI Xi Fang, PhD Associate Professor School of Medicine University of California, San Diego
